planning_notes: Board is Uno as required; wiring uses only D3 (button input) and D10 (LED output).
Empty supplied pins means no additional pin overrides; all required functional pins are represented above.
Button edge/toggle behavior belongs to the SysML model; the digital_input port only provides the instantaneous button state.
No serial reporting or serial receive requirements were provided.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button press command trigger (each press toggles LED state)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED switch state (toggled once per button press), model boolean controls LED on/off

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 使用 D3 引脚的按钮控制 D10 LED 开关，按一次切换一次状态。

requirements.text: 使用 D3 引脚的按钮控制 D10 LED 开关，按一次切换一次状态。
